snippet.title: 8 Hours Till Dawn - Trailer 1
snippet.description:
The official first trailer for 8 Hours Till Dawn, a friend-slop party survival game, where you pre-program your survivor's movements and actions. Then watch your plans unfold in usually a chaotic mess. Can you survive the night in 8 Hours Till Dawn. Currently in early playtesting, more survivors, weapons, maps, and a huge rouge-lite campaign mode planned on the road map. 

1 - 6 players Co-op

PC - Steam, 

Playtest on steam now, coming October 2026!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4688730/8_Hours_Till_Dawn/

Want to learn more about the history of building this game, or other cool projects I've been working on? check out my website!
